title: Prove minimum affine group-algebra carrier dimension q+h-1 (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. For every finite field F_q of characteristic p, subgroup H of F_q* of order h, and coefficient field K with char K != p, the minimum faithful linear dimension of K[F_q semidirect H] is exactly q+h-1. This includes coefficient characteristics dividing h.

```diff
- regular group carrier: qh coordinates
+ augmentation plus regular H quotient: q+h-1 coordinates, optimal
```

The proof supplies an explicit affine-line coefficient inverse and classifies the natural action's complete (h-1)-dimensional algebra kernel. This gives smaller exact formal-identity checks. It supplies no native word, paid supplier invoice or new kappa.

## Evidence

Local CPython 3.12.15, standard library only. Both warning-strict registered normal/optimized commands pass, timed individually at 1.084 and 1.145 seconds. Exact output is `PASS_AFFINE_ALGEBRA_MINIMAL_CARRIER`, with zero errors in 54 coefficient contexts, 13,269 group-product pairs, 1,808 field triples, 1,683 coefficient-vector recoveries, 1,380 rational coefficient recoveries and 96 kernel-basis checks. Nine controls include invalid domains, malformed algebra images and a failing excluded-characteristic fixture.

The all-field lower bound and construction are written proofs; finite checks corroborate them. The checker constructs its own finite fields and matrices and imports no predecessor scientific verifier. The generated receipt binds all seven package files by SHA256. Metadata, committed bytes and declared source history pass. Official export integrity passes; normal/optimized replay from a read-only Git-free export also passes with every exported file unchanged.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/affine-algebra-minimal-carrier
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/affine-algebra-minimal-carrier/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/affine-algebra-minimal-carrier/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/affine-algebra-minimal-carrier --check-source-history
```

Other hosts may substitute their CPython 3.12 path. Both VERIFY.json commands ran locally under their 120-second limits. The README explains optional exclusive-create receipt generation outside the checkout.

## Scope and credit

Original question; `bit-new-register-model` explicitly changes scope to this algebraic verifier interface. Canonical main was fetched at entry and before publication, unchanged at e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. The first source-binding command passes. The catalogue's revision-8 assessment predates selected #7000; no selected file or frontier changes. The [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19592134) states the same delivered mathematical scope.

Credit aliromman #5394 for the formal/natural distinction and order-21 alias, retaining 1337isnot1337 #2011's model and JoyboyBrian's support lineage. This context is cited rather than audited. Classical translation averaging, character orthogonality, cyclic group algebras and Cayley-Hamilton retain their credit; no literature-priority claim is made for those ingredients. The coefficient inverse, complete kernel classification, explicit carrier and matching dimension result are the contribution here.

The optimum permits arbitrary linear matrices. Characteristic p, permutation/native realization, physical source preparation, ownership, routing, dirty restoration, precision, compiler closure, complete invoices and outer admission remain outside the result. All five selected framework assumptions remain. No selected scientific replay, native execution, Lean or Docker run was performed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Determine a smallest faithful permutation carrier in a specified admissible action class. Start with the natural orbit and an H quotient orbit; the linear optimum need not be a permutation action.
- Determine the minimum in the excluded characteristic p. Start with the F3/S3 radical; the present averaging inverse does not apply.
- Bind one actual formal-word checker to this carrier and measure its complete cost while preserving every coefficient field and basis column. A dimension reduction alone is not a runtime speedup.

## Related open work

- [#7213](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7213) proves formal diagonal rank cost for every group and field. This PR instead gives an exact smaller faithful representation for the stated affine groups; no paid-cost comparison or additional computation of that PR's quantities is made.

Live open/account PRs, recent handoffs, local claims, merged-PR searches and main README searches were checked before claiming and committing. The overlap helper reports complete pagination of 810 open PRs and 7,424 Discussion records, with incomplete sparse local-note coverage. This is bounded overlap evidence, not proof of global novelty.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At unchanged head `8b8134a77db03bd5ce8fb0e7de9cb96f90fad7cc`, [run 43443411218](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43443411218), [plan job 131946565061](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43443411218/job/131946565061), failed in `Onboarding helper tests`. Exactly one of 760 tests failed, with 24 skipped:

```text
test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record
AssertionError: '`make frontier7000-verify`' not found
```

I read the completed checks once and inspected the actual job log. The assertion is at test line 58. The `replay` job was skipped because `plan` failed, so no hosted package replay ran. Local normal/optimized and registered checks remain the evidence reported above.

The cause is present in canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`: `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes selected #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify`. Both files and the failing test are unchanged in this PR, as confirmed by an empty Git diff against that base for these paths. This is a repository-level navigation failure, not a package failure.

I independently inspected these five comparison logs. Each has the same sole failing test, missing-command assertion, 760-test total and 24 skips; each package replay was skipped:

- [42905094314, plan job 130140894651](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314/job/130140894651).
- [42903313790, plan job 130134720799](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790/job/130134720799).
- [43442573607, plan job 131943660589](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43442573607/job/131943660589).
- [43442770498, plan job 131944347029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43442770498/job/131944347029).
- [43442961599, plan job 131945014684](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43442961599/job/131945014684).

No fix, retrigger commit, push or workflow rerun was made. Maintainers own the repair of main.

The completion refresh read this account's seven other open PRs created since the CLAIM, #7511 through #7517. Their objects are the six-point sojourn, shared Fourier error, F9 transport fixed spaces, two-epoch fanout, two-axis word lengths, private Gaussian headers and cyclic-chain generation. None computes this affine group-algebra carrier dimension. The existing Related open work entry #7213 remains sufficient; no competing number was identified or additionally computed.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Seven new files under research/affine-algebra-minimal-carrier; no shared implementation, frozen evidence or selected-frontier files change.
